description: Default capabilities for the desktop window. Slice 2 added the dialog plugin permission so `cmd_pick_project` can open the native folder picker. Slice 3 widens the window label pattern to `main*` so the launcher can spawn one window per project (e.g. `main-<hash>`) under the same capability. The dialog permission and core defaults cover everything the launcher needs; webview-window create/close are core operations and do not need an explicit permission on Tauri 2.x.
